g.text: Higher input SNR meets the precision target under an assumed frontend
48 independent FIDs; colored bands: pointwise 95% whole-record bootstrap intervals.
100 Hz causal bandpass; threshold 0.0001 A0; 200 MHz clock; 1 microHz output rounding.
Gray band: pixel-reading range. The 80 dB case changes the stated paper conditions.
